item.title: US stocks soar to their best day since May as the Dow tops 50,000 and bitcoin stops plunging
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — The U.S. stock market roared back on Friday, as technology stocks recovered much of their losses from earlier in the week and bitcoin halted its plunge, at least for now.

item.title: Jason Momoa’s band OOF TATATA to perform free show at ilani
item.description: Jason Momoa and his band, ÖOF TATATÁ, will offer a free performance at 8 p.m. Monday at ilani Casino Resort’s Rock & Brews restaurant and bar.

item.title: Woman dies after struck by car in east Vancouver
item.description: A woman died Friday after being hit by a car in east Vancouver, according to a news release from the Vancouver Police Department.

item.title: Clark County to pay $400,000 to settle lawsuit filed by former Clark County Jail inmate
item.description: Clark County has agreed to pay $400,000 to settle a federal civil rights lawsuit filed by a former jail inmate who alleged deputies used excessive force when they attached a tether to his handcuffs and dragged him across a cell floor in 2021.

item.title: Environmental activist Erin Brockovich to speak at Spokane Women Helping Women Fund
item.description: SPOKANE — Famed environmental activist Erin Brockovich is coming to Spokane.

item.title: County staffer to run for Clark County auditor
item.description: Mitchell Kelly, reporting and analysis manager in the Clark County Auditor’s Office, announced he is running for county auditor in the next election.

item.title: Battle Ground man dies after being struck by a car in Walmart parking lot
item.description: A man died Friday after being struck by a car in the parking lot of the Battle Ground Walmart, according to a news release from the Battle Ground Police Department.

item.title: Blazers rout Grizzlies, 135-115, end six-game losing streak
item.description: Jerami Grant had 23 points and the Portland Trail Blazers snapped a six-game losing streak, beating the Memphis Grizzlies 135-115 on Friday night to open a two-game set.
